scope: All 18 image references in the 136-page Chinese Markdown corpus: two local PNG files, fifteen remote workflow assets, and one remote HTML img.
verification_method: Local files were decoded from the pinned cache. Remote bytes were retrieved from the exact source URL on 2026-09-04 into a temporary audit directory, hashed, decoded, and visually inspected. Static images were inspected in full. GIF frame counts were read from the decoded files, but only the preview frame returned by the image viewer was visually inspected; animation sequences were not exhaustively reviewed.
limitations: Only three corpus pages contain images, so the image-page sample is 3/3 rather than the skill's preferred 5–10 image-bearing pages.
All fifteen workflow Markdown images have empty alt text; the audit describes seen pixels but does not retroactively claim those descriptions exist in the source.
Temporary downloads and screenshots are verification aids and are not committed with this manifest. SHA-256 hashes identify the exact inspected bytes.
